name: Town of Hempstead Mah-Jongg Classes
description: Town of Hempstead Fall 2026 beginner / advanced beginner / intermediate classes (Speno Park East Meadow; Merrick Golf Course Clubhouse). Page says: 'Participants must obtain the 2026 National Mah Jongg League card' (paraphrased from town page). Venues are in East Meadow and Merrick near Bellmore. Registration opened 2026-09-10; sessions already started.
schedule: Beginner Tue 10:30am-12:30pm and 12:45pm-2:45pm Oct 6-Dec 8 (no class 11/3); Advanced Beginner Mon 10am-12pm Oct 5-Dec 7; Intermediate Wed 1-3pm Sep 30-Dec 16 at Merrick Golf Course Clubhouse. Fee $108 ($54 seniors/veterans) beginner; $120 ($60) intermediate.
